technology_name: Device for Demonstrating the Stress Stiffening Effect and Method Thereof
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional instrumentation setups cannot rapidly, safely, and cheaply isolate the stress stiffening profile of material sheets under varying axial force windows.
description: A specialized structural validation machine constructed with an enclosed acoustic testing chamber, an adjustable material load frame, and an active Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) control system to model material stress loads instantly.
applications: Advanced materials research laboratories, aerospace structural test facilities, civil engineering concrete/composite validation setups, and educational mechanics instruments.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Robotics, Automation & Drones, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
